_comment: Channel -> hemibrain cell types, matched by EXACT name; a trailing '*' expands by prefix.
This map is written for the vendored one-hop subset in data/hemibrain_subset.json.gz.
The subset is real: LC4 and LPLC2 contact the giant fibre and descending escape neurons
through the EM connectome. The reproductive pC1 -> DNp13 path is a commitment gate, not a
steering decoder: DNp13 is a song command neuron, not a heading cell. Muse chooses the goal.

loom_speed.note: Angular-velocity-sensitive lobula columnar neuron; contacts the giant fibre.

loom_size.note: Looming-size selective; the other main giant-fibre input.

target.note: Small-object tracking. Present in the subset; no calibrated pursuit decoder is claimed.

sound.note: No Johnston's-organ type is present in the one-hop hemibrain subset. Silence is honest.

arousal.note: P1/pC1 reproductive state. Muse raises this when it chooses to investigate a candidate. In this subset it drives DNp13, a song command neuron; it does not encode a heading.

gf.note: The giant fibre. Treat a spike as a trigger event, never as a rate.

jump.note: Descending escape outputs present in the hemibrain subset. TTMn is a VNC motor neuron and is not in this brain-only dataset.

flight_power.note: Descending neurons in the escape/visual neighbourhood, used as the power-recruitment readout.

steer.note: Not calibrated. Muse supplies the mission goal; this decoder is intentionally empty.

forward.note: Not calibrated. Muse supplies the mission goal; this decoder is intentionally empty.

courtship.note: The reproductive neurons (pC1) plus their DNp13 target. The spike count gates approach commitment in MotorLayer; it is not used as a direction. pC1 is also the arousal input, so the injected train is counted as the reproductive event.
